caveat: Load is not measured by any sensor here. The estimate is documented capacity, or roofed area × a density prior, times a utilisation assumption. Night-time roof temperature does not respond to load (see the overnight report); NO2 plumes indicate on-site combustion only; Sentinel-2 dates roofs and fit-out.
